{{Quote|What kind of galaxy is it when a man can't enjoy himself on holiday?|Venar|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
[[Baron/Legends|Baron]] '''Venar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] noble of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] living during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. While he was hiding in a secret hideout in the [[Alsakan Lowlands]], Venar was blackmailed by [[Risha Drayen]] who possessed unfavorable holorecordings of his vacation on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. She sent a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] to barter those holos in exchange for access to a [[House of Thul|House Thul]] spaceport.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Biography==
Sometime by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates1">{{TOR_dates|1}} As Venar's vacation must take place prior to the events on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] for the Smuggler class, which happen in Act I, they must happen sometime during or prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Venar had taken a vacation to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shadda]]. [[Risha Drayen]] would eventually come into possession of [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecordings]] of his trip.<ref name="SWTOR" />
